[21] AR: فَخَرَجَ مِنْهَا خَآئِفًۭا يَتَرَقَّبُ ۖ قَالَ رَبِّ نَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ EN: So he left it, fearful and anticipating [apprehension].

folded.id: establish them|in|the land and show pharaoh and [his minister] haman and their soldiers through them that which they had feared
folded.subject: establish them
folded.object: the land and show Pharaoh and [his minister] Haman and their soldiers through them that which they had feared

spans.text: [6] AR: وَنُمَكِّنَ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَنُرِىَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ وَجُنُودَهُمَا مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَحْذَرُونَ EN: And establish them in the land and show Pharaoh and [his minister] Haman and their soldiers through them that which they had feared.

folded.id: full strength|and|was [mentally] mature
folded.subject: full strength
folded.object: was [mentally] mature

spans.text: [14] AR: وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ وَٱسْتَوَىٰٓ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُ حُكْمًۭا وَعِلْمًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ EN: And when he attained his full strength and was [mentally] mature, We bestowed upon him judgement and knowledge.

folded.id: he|is|a manifest
folded.subject: he
folded.object: a manifest

spans.text: Indeed, he is a manifest, misleading enemy."

folded.id: he|is|the forgiving
folded.subject: He
folded.object: the Forgiving

spans.text: Indeed, He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

folded.id: he|will|be] a comfort of the eye for me and for you
folded.subject: He
folded.object: be] a comfort of the eye for me and for you

spans.text: [9] AR: وَقَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ فِرْعَوْنَ قُرَّتُ عَيْنٍۢ لِّى وَلَكَ ۖ لَا تَقْتُلُوهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًۭا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ EN: And the wife of Pharaoh said, "[He will be] a comfort of the eye for me and for you.

folded.id: help to|him|against the one from his enemy
folded.subject: help to
folded.object: against the one from his enemy

spans.text: And the one from his faction called for help to him against the one from his enemy, so Moses struck him and [unintentionally] killed him.

folded.id: household that|will|be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?"
folded.subject: household that
folded.object: be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?"

spans.text: [12] AR: ۞ وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍۢ يَكْفُلُونَهُۥ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ نَٰصِحُونَ EN: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?"

folded.id: i|will|never be an assistant to the criminals
folded.subject: I
folded.object: never be an assistant to the criminals

spans.text: [17] AR: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ فَلَنْ أَكُونَ ظَهِيرًۭا لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ EN: He said, "My Lord, for the favor You bestowed upon me, I will never be an assistant to the criminals."

folded.id: its people|and|found therein two men fighting: one from his faction and one from among his enemy
folded.subject: its people
folded.object: found therein two men fighting: one from his faction and one from among his enemy

spans.text: [15] AR: وَدَخَلَ ٱلْمَدِينَةَ عَلَىٰ حِينِ غَفْلَةٍۢ مِّنْ أَهْلِهَا فَوَجَدَ فِيهَا رَجُلَيْنِ يَقْتَتِلَانِ هَٰذَا مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ وَهَٰذَا مِنْ عَدُوِّهِۦ ۖ فَٱسْتَغَٰثَهُ ٱلَّذِى مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ عَلَى ٱلَّذِى مِنْ عَدُوِّهِۦ فَوَكَزَهُۥ مُوسَىٰ فَقَضَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ۖ قَالَ هَٰذَا مِنْ عَمَلِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّضِلٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ EN: And he entered the city at a time of inattention by its people and found therein two men fighting: one from his faction and one from among his enemy.

folded.id: may adopt|him|as a son

folded.object: as a son

spans.text: Do not kill him; perhaps he may benefit us, or we may adopt him as a son."

folded.id: moses|said|to him
folded.subject: Moses
folded.object: to him

spans.text: Moses said to him, "Indeed, you are an evident, [persistent] deviator."

folded.subject: my Lord
folded.object: guide me to the sound way

spans.text: [22] AR: وَلَمَّا تَوَجَّهَ تِلْقَآءَ مَدْيَنَ قَالَ عَسَىٰ رَبِّىٓ أَن يَهْدِيَنِى سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ EN: And when he directed himself toward Madyan, he said, "Perhaps my Lord will guide me to the sound way."

folded.id: of moses|and|pharaoh in truth for a people who believe

folded.object: Pharaoh in truth for a people who believe

spans.text: [8] AR: فَٱلْتَقَطَهُۥٓ ءَالُ فِرْعَوْنَ لِيَكُونَ لَهُمْ عَدُوًّۭا وَحَزَنًا ۗ إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ وَجُنُودَهُمَا كَانُوا۟ خَٰطِـِٔينَ EN: And the family of Pharaoh picked him up [out of the river] so that he would become to them an enemy and a [cause of] grief.

folded.id: our father|is|an old man

folded.object: an old man

spans.text: They said, "We do not water until the shepherds dispatch [their flocks]; and our father is an old man."

folded.object: himself in the land and made its people into factions

spans.text: [4] AR: إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ عَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَجَعَلَ أَهْلَهَا شِيَعًۭا يَسْتَضْعِفُ طَآئِفَةًۭ مِّنْهُمْ يُذَبِّحُ أَبْنَآءَهُمْ وَيَسْتَحْىِۦ نِسَآءَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ EN: Indeed, Pharaoh exalted himself in the land and made its people into factions, oppressing a sector among them, slaughtering their [newborn] sons and keeping their females alive.

folded.object: from a distance while they perceived not

folded.id: so moses|struck|him and [unintentionally] killed him
folded.subject: so Moses
folded.object: him and [unintentionally] killed him

folded.subject: sons
folded.object: keeping their females alive

spans.text: [4] AR: إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ عَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَجَعَلَ أَهْلَهَا شِيَعًۭا يَسْتَضْعِفُ طَآئِفَةًۭ مِّنْهُمْ يُذَبِّحُ أَبْنَآءَهُمْ وَيَسْتَحْىِۦ نِسَآءَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ EN: Indeed, Pharaoh exalted himself in the land and made its people into factions, oppressing a sector among them, slaughtering their [newborn] sons and keeping their females alive.

folded.object: said

spans.text: [24] AR: فَسَقَىٰ لَهُمَا ثُمَّ تَوَلَّىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلظِّلِّ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى لِمَآ أَنزَلْتَ إِلَىَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍۢ فَقِيرٌۭ EN: So he watered [their flocks] for them; then he went back to the shade and said, "My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need."

folded.id: this|is|from the work of satan

folded.subject: to disclose
folded.object: had We not bound fast her heart that she would be of the believers

spans.text: She was about to disclose [the matter concerning] him had We not bound fast her heart that she would be of the believers.

folded.object: to his mother that she might be content and not grieve and that she would know that the promise of Allah is true

spans.text: [13] AR: فَرَدَدْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّهِۦ كَىْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ وَلِتَعْلَمَ أَنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ EN: So We restored him to his mother that she might be content and not grieve and that she would know that the promise of Allah is true.

folded.object: the land and make them leaders and make them inheritors
